build_sam2base_model: build a SAM2Base model with an image encoder, memory attention module, and memory encoder for video segmentation
run_forward_sam_heads: run the SAM prompt encoder and mask decoder to produce low and high resolution mask predictions from backbone features
run_track_step: run a single tracking step on a video frame using point inputs, mask inputs, and memory-conditioned visual features
run_encode_new_memory: run the memory encoder to encode predicted high-res masks and vision features into a new memory feature for future frames
run_apply_non_overlapping_constraints: run non-overlapping constraints on predicted masks to keep only the highest scoring object at each spatial location
